sourceTitle: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
originalTitle: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: As our models get smarter and take more consequential actions in the world, it becomes increasingly important that they go beyond just interpreting the specific instructions they receive. Models also need to understand human intentions and values, so they can exercise good judgment in situations their instructions don’t explicitly address while remaining faithful to human intent and oversight.
blocks.en: As our models get smarter and take more consequential actions in the world, it becomes increasingly important that they go beyond just interpreting the specific instructions they receive. Models also need to understand human intentions and values, so they can exercise good judgment in situations their instructions don’t explicitly address while remaining faithful to human intent and oversight.
blocks.zh: 随着我们的模型变得更加智能，其在现实世界中采取的行动也带来更深远的影响，模型就越来越不能止步于理解收到的具体指令。模型还需要理解人类的意图和价值观，才能在指令未明确涵盖的情境中作出恰当判断，同时始终忠于人类意图并接受人类监督。

blocks.text: Today we’re updating the Model Spec, our public description of how we want our models to behave. The update reorganizes its guidance around five underlying values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. This reflects an aim of our work on value alignment: for models to understand and apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining faithful to human intent. Alongside clearer explanations of existing principles, the revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, adjusts some behavioral defaults, and retires much of the detailed style guidance.
blocks.en: Today we’re updating the Model Spec, our public description of how we want our models to behave. The update reorganizes its guidance around five underlying values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. This reflects an aim of our work on value alignment: for models to understand and apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining faithful to human intent. Alongside clearer explanations of existing principles, the revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, adjusts some behavioral defaults, and retires much of the detailed style guidance.
blocks.zh: 今天，我们更新了模型规范。这份公开文件阐述了我们期望模型如何行事。本次更新围绕五项基本价值观重新组织了规范中的指导原则：忠于人类意图、尽量减少伤害、诚实与透明、人的自主性以及关怀。这体现了我们在价值观对齐方面的一项目标：让模型在陌生情境中也能理解并运用人类价值观，同时始终忠于人类意图。此次修订不仅更清晰地解释了现有原则，还增加了有关上下文、监督和自主性的指导，调整了部分默认行为，并移除了大部分细化的风格指导。

blocks.text: Organizing the Spec around core values
blocks.en: Organizing the Spec around core values
blocks.zh: 围绕核心价值观组织规范

blocks.text: The five values above articulate broad commitments already reflected across the Model Spec: serving human purposes, being truthful, minimizing harm, respecting people’s freedom to form their own views, and taking their circumstances seriously. Bringing these commitments together helps explain why the Spec asks models to behave as it does, and helps us develop clearer guidance where those commitments were less fully expressed. This update is another step in our work to refine the Spec through research, experience deploying models, public feedback on the Spec and model behavior, and discussions with users and outside experts.
blocks.en: The five values above articulate broad commitments already reflected across the Model Spec: serving human purposes, being truthful, minimizing harm, respecting people’s freedom to form their own views, and taking their circumstances seriously. Bringing these commitments together helps explain why the Spec asks models to behave as it does, and helps us develop clearer guidance where those commitments were less fully expressed. This update is another step in our work to refine the Spec through research, experience deploying models, public feedback on the Spec and model behavior, and discussions with users and outside experts.
blocks.zh: 上述五项价值观明确表达了模型规范中已有的基本承诺：服务于人类的目标、如实表达、尽量减少伤害、尊重人们形成独立观点的自由，以及认真对待他们所处的境况。将这些承诺集中呈现，有助于解释规范为何对模型提出这些行为要求，也有助于我们针对以往表述不够充分的部分制定更清晰的指导。我们一直在通过研究、模型部署经验、公众对规范和模型行为的反馈，以及与用户和外部专家的讨论来完善规范。此次更新是这项工作的又一步。

blocks.text: We want AI to benefit a world of people with different needs, values, and hopes for the future.
blocks.en: We want AI to benefit a world of people with different needs, values, and hopes for the future.
blocks.zh: 世界各地的人们有着不同的需求、价值观和对未来的期望，我们希望 AI 能让他们都受益。

blocks.text: Faithfulness to human intent is the foundation of this approach: understanding and helping people pursue what matters to them. OpenAI writes the Spec, sets boundaries, and trains models to respect them; developers direct applications within those boundaries; and users direct the model’s work subject to those constraints. Our models should expand people’s ability to shape their own lives by helping them understand the world, discover possibilities, and pursue the goals they choose, while taking seriously how that assistance affects others. Faithfulness to human intent and the remaining four values organize the Spec and guide how our models should navigate some of the most important trade-offs they face. They are not intended to capture the full range of human values our models should respect and help people pursue.
blocks.en: Faithfulness to human intent is the foundation of this approach: understanding and helping people pursue what matters to them. OpenAI writes the Spec, sets boundaries, and trains models to respect them; developers direct applications within those boundaries; and users direct the model’s work subject to those constraints. Our models should expand people’s ability to shape their own lives by helping them understand the world, discover possibilities, and pursue the goals they choose, while taking seriously how that assistance affects others. Faithfulness to human intent and the remaining four values organize the Spec and guide how our models should navigate some of the most important trade-offs they face. They are not intended to capture the full range of human values our models should respect and help people pursue.
blocks.zh: 忠于人类意图是这一思路的基础：理解什么对人们重要，并帮助他们去追求。OpenAI 编写规范、设定边界，并训练模型遵守这些边界；开发者在这些边界内决定应用如何运作；用户则在这些约束下指挥模型开展工作。我们的模型应帮助人们理解世界、发现可能性并追求自己选择的目标，从而增强人们塑造自身生活的能力，同时认真考虑这些帮助会如何影响他人。忠于人类意图与其余四项价值观共同构成了规范的框架，并指导模型如何应对一些最重要的权衡取舍。它们并不旨在涵盖模型应尊重并帮助人们追求的全部人类价值观。

blocks.text: Faithfulness means going beyond following instructions literally to deeply understanding what OpenAI, developers, and users intend and value, and acting wisely when that understanding is incomplete. It also means recognizing that people’s beliefs and values can change, and helping them reflect and grow in ways they would endorse without quietly steering them or overriding their choices. For example, when helping someone compare job offers, the model might draw on priorities they have shared before—such as predictable hours—while making those assumptions visible and easy to correct.
blocks.en: Faithfulness means going beyond following instructions literally to deeply understanding what OpenAI, developers, and users intend and value, and acting wisely when that understanding is incomplete. It also means recognizing that people’s beliefs and values can change, and helping them reflect and grow in ways they would endorse without quietly steering them or overriding their choices. For example, when helping someone compare job offers, the model might draw on priorities they have shared before—such as predictable hours—while making those assumptions visible and easy to correct.
blocks.zh: 忠于人类意图，意味着不能仅按字面执行指令，而要深入理解 OpenAI、开发者和用户的意图及其重视的事物，并在理解尚不完整时明智地行事。这也意味着要认识到，人们的信念和价值观可能发生变化，并以他们认可的方式帮助他们反思与成长，而不是暗中引导他们或擅自推翻他们的选择。例如，在帮助用户比较工作邀约时，模型可能会参考用户之前提到的优先考虑因素，如工作时间安排可预期，同时明确说明所依据的假设，让用户能够轻松纠正。

blocks.text: Our mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. This requires considering not only someone’s immediate intentions, but also their longer-term interests and the effects on others. The other four values make these considerations explicit:
blocks.en: Our mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. This requires considering not only someone’s immediate intentions, but also their longer-term interests and the effects on others. The other four values make these considerations explicit:
blocks.zh: 我们的使命是确保通用人工智能造福全人类。这要求我们不仅考虑一个人当下的意图，还要考虑其长远利益以及对他人的影响。其余四项价值观明确了这些考量：

blocks.text: Minimizing harm means respecting firm safety boundaries and accounting for the foreseeable consequences of the model’s actions.
blocks.en: Minimizing harm means respecting firm safety boundaries and accounting for the foreseeable consequences of the model’s actions.
blocks.zh: 尽量减少伤害，意味着遵守不可逾越的安全边界，并考虑模型行动可能带来的可预见后果。

blocks.text: Honesty and transparency mean being truthful about what the model knows, does, and is uncertain about so people can understand and evaluate its reasoning and work.
blocks.en: Honesty and transparency mean being truthful about what the model knows, does, and is uncertain about so people can understand and evaluate its reasoning and work.
blocks.zh: 诚实与透明，意味着如实说明模型知道什么、做了什么，以及对哪些事情尚不确定，让人们能够理解和评估其推理与工作。

blocks.text: Facilitating human agency means strengthening people’s ability to understand, choose, and act for themselves.
blocks.en: Facilitating human agency means strengthening people’s ability to understand, choose, and act for themselves.
blocks.zh: 促进人的自主性，意味着增强人们自主理解、选择和行动的能力。

blocks.text: Care means attending to the circumstances of those affected, following relevant social and professional norms, and doing work people can rely on.
blocks.en: Care means attending to the circumstances of those affected, following relevant social and professional norms, and doing work people can rely on.
blocks.zh: 关怀，意味着关注受影响者的境况，遵循相关社会规范和专业准则，并提供值得信赖的工作成果。

blocks.text: The Spec turns these values into practical guidance, with firm boundaries where needed to protect people and society, and otherwise mostly takes the form of defaults that users and developers can override.
blocks.en: The Spec turns these values into practical guidance, with firm boundaries where needed to protect people and society, and otherwise mostly takes the form of defaults that users and developers can override.
blocks.zh: 规范将这些价值观转化为切实可行的指导，在必要之处设立不可逾越的边界，以保护个人和社会；其余内容则大多是用户和开发者可通过指令覆盖的默认规则。

blocks.text: Alongside this Model Spec update, we’ve been exploring new training methods to help our models learn these core values and better understand and follow the Spec’s specific behavioral principles. The aim is to build an understanding of why those principles matter and how to apply them in new situations: to do the right things for the right reasons. We want that understanding to support sound judgment in consequential decisions and care in everyday decisions that can add up to lasting benefits for people and society. We’ll share results and lessons from this training work in future updates.
blocks.en: Alongside this Model Spec update, we’ve been exploring new training methods to help our models learn these core values and better understand and follow the Spec’s specific behavioral principles. The aim is to build an understanding of why those principles matter and how to apply them in new situations: to do the right things for the right reasons. We want that understanding to support sound judgment in consequential decisions and care in everyday decisions that can add up to lasting benefits for people and society. We’ll share results and lessons from this training work in future updates.
blocks.zh: 在更新模型规范的同时，我们也一直在探索新的训练方法，帮助模型学习这些核心价值观，更好地理解并遵循规范中的具体行为原则。目标是让模型理解这些原则为何重要，以及如何在新情境中运用它们：出于正确的理由，做正确的事。我们希望，这种理解能帮助模型在重大决策中作出恰当判断，在日常决策中体现关怀，日积月累，为个人和社会带来持久的益处。我们将在后续更新中分享这项训练工作的结果与经验教训。

blocks.text: New and retired sections
blocks.en: New and retired sections
blocks.zh: 新增与移除的章节

blocks.text: This reorganization also helped us identify where additional guidance was needed, develop new principles to address it, and revise or retire existing guidance as needed.
blocks.en: This reorganization also helped us identify where additional guidance was needed, develop new principles to address it, and revise or retire existing guidance as needed.
blocks.zh: 这次重组也帮助我们识别出哪些方面需要补充指导，为此制定新原则，并按需修订或移除现有指导。

blocks.text: The new section on faithfulness to human intent starts from the idea that what people value is primary, and instructions are ordinarily the clearest and most important signals of those values. This approach borrows from the assistance-games framing of alignment (see early work and a later overview). The section incorporates an updated chain of command, which explains which instructions apply and how conflicts are resolved. A new subsection, consider context carefully, explains how conversations, memories, and other contextual evidence should inform the model’s understanding of people’s intentions and preferences.
blocks.en: The new section on faithfulness to human intent starts from the idea that what people value is primary, and instructions are ordinarily the clearest and most important signals of those values. This approach borrows from the assistance-games framing of alignment (see early work and a later overview). The section incorporates an updated chain of command, which explains which instructions apply and how conflicts are resolved. A new subsection, consider context carefully, explains how conversations, memories, and other contextual evidence should inform the model’s understanding of people’s intentions and preferences.
blocks.zh: 新增的“忠于人类意图”一节以这样一个理念为出发点：人们所珍视的事物才是根本，而指令通常是表达这些价值观最清晰、最重要的信号。这一思路借鉴了对齐研究中的辅助博弈框架（参见早期研究和后续综述）。这一节纳入了更新后的指令层级，解释了哪些指令适用，以及如何解决指令冲突。新增的小节审慎考虑上下文阐述了模型应如何根据对话、记忆及其他上下文线索，理解人们的意图和偏好。

blocks.text: We’ve also added defaults on supporting human agency and following relevant social norms, and expanded existing guidance on controlling and communicating side effects. These principles capture additional, often subtle but important ways the remaining values should surface in model behavior: considering the effects of the work on others, strengthening users’ capabilities, and producing work people can rely on, while respecting the user’s goals and instructions.
blocks.en: We’ve also added defaults on supporting human agency and following relevant social norms, and expanded existing guidance on controlling and communicating side effects. These principles capture additional, often subtle but important ways the remaining values should surface in model behavior: considering the effects of the work on others, strengthening users’ capabilities, and producing work people can rely on, while respecting the user’s goals and instructions.
blocks.zh: 我们还增加了关于支持人的自主性和遵循相关社会规范的默认规则，并扩充了有关控制和说明附带影响的现有指导。这些原则进一步明确了其余价值观应如何体现在模型行为中，其中许多细节虽不显眼，却十分重要：在尊重用户目标和指令的同时，考虑工作对他人的影响、增强用户的能力，并提供值得信赖的工作成果。

blocks.text: At the same time, we’re retiring most of the Spec’s detailed style guidance. Style should adapt to what people prefer—in aggregate, within languages and cultures, and for each person—with user feedback and context providing evidence about those preferences. The Spec retains stronger defaults, such as approaching questions objectively. Users and developers can explicitly ask the model to take a particular perspective, but the model should not infer that preference merely from what it thinks they want to hear.
blocks.en: At the same time, we’re retiring most of the Spec’s detailed style guidance. Style should adapt to what people prefer—in aggregate, within languages and cultures, and for each person—with user feedback and context providing evidence about those preferences. The Spec retains stronger defaults, such as approaching questions objectively. Users and developers can explicitly ask the model to take a particular perspective, but the model should not infer that preference merely from what it thinks they want to hear.
blocks.zh: 与此同时，我们移除了规范中大部分细化的风格指导。风格应适应人们的偏好，既要考虑普遍偏好，也要考虑不同语言、文化和个人的偏好，而用户反馈和上下文可以为了解这些偏好提供依据。规范仍保留了约束更强的默认规则，例如客观看待问题。用户和开发者可以明确要求模型采用特定视角，但模型不应仅凭自己对他们想听什么的猜测，就认定他们有这种偏好。

blocks.text: Finally, reflecting the increasing breadth of our models’ use cases and deployment settings, we now refer to the model as “GPT” rather than “the assistant” in the Spec.
blocks.en: Finally, reflecting the increasing breadth of our models’ use cases and deployment settings, we now refer to the model as “GPT” rather than “the assistant” in the Spec.
blocks.zh: 最后，随着模型的使用场景和部署环境日益多样，我们现在在规范中使用“GPT”而非“助手”来指代模型。

blocks.text: What comes next
blocks.en: What comes next
blocks.zh: 未来展望

blocks.text: This update is a first step in making the values and reasoning behind the Spec more explicit as models become more capable. The Model Spec describes the behavior we are working toward; our models do not yet fully reflect it. We will keep improving both the Spec and the models as we learn from research, real-world use, and feedback.
blocks.en: This update is a first step in making the values and reasoning behind the Spec more explicit as models become more capable. The Model Spec describes the behavior we are working toward; our models do not yet fully reflect it. We will keep improving both the Spec and the models as we learn from research, real-world use, and feedback.
blocks.zh: 随着模型能力不断增强，此次更新是我们更明确地阐述规范背后的价值观及相关考量的第一步。模型规范描述的是我们努力实现的行为目标；目前，我们的模型尚未完全达到这些要求。我们将持续从研究、实际使用和反馈中汲取经验，不断改进规范和模型。

blocks.text: We want to hear which parts of the Spec you find compelling, where you disagree with the balance it strikes, and what it overlooks or leaves unclear. Feedback on the values, trade-offs, and specific language can help us improve it. We invite you to read the updated Model Spec and share your perspective.
blocks.en: We want to hear which parts of the Spec you find compelling, where you disagree with the balance it strikes, and what it overlooks or leaves unclear. Feedback on the values, trade-offs, and specific language can help us improve it. We invite you to read the updated Model Spec and share your perspective.
blocks.zh: 我们希望听到你的看法：你认为规范的哪些内容有说服力，你在哪些方面不认同它所作的权衡，以及它遗漏了什么、还有哪些地方不够清晰。你对价值观、权衡取舍和具体措辞的反馈，都能帮助我们完善规范。欢迎阅读更新后的模型规范，并分享你的看法。
